candidates.label: BFS diameter over every declared person, including isolated people not named by an edge.
Incorrect: ignores people absent from the relationship list.

Always prints a trailing blank line after every network, including the very last one -- the sample output has no blank line after the final network, so this diverges on the overall trailing whitespace even though every individual answer is numerically correct.

Treats relationships as directed (only pushes b onto a's adjacency list, not the reverse) instead of the stated symmetric relationship -- shortest paths and reachability both become wrong on any graph that isn't already symmetric-by-coincidence.
